title: SCU Pegasus: Design-Build-Vertical Flight
subtitle: Senior design: the electrical system of a search and rescue hexacopter
pitch: My senior design team, SCU Pegasus, is building a search and rescue hexacopter for the Vertical Flight Society's Design-Build-Vertical Flight student competition. I am the team's electrical engineer.
highlights: Responsible for the electronics, software, and automation of the aircraft
Six electrical areas, all mine: payload electronics, navigation and GPS, autonomy and physical AI, electrical safety switches and mechanisms, communication and RF, and power distribution
A team of five students: four mechanical engineers and me, a double major in mechanical and electrical engineering
Coordinating with the mechanical engineers on structures and payload
A team project, credited to the team

blocks.md: For academic year 2026 to 2027, my senior design team, SCU Pegasus, is Santa Clara University's entry in the Vertical Flight Society's Design-Build-Vertical Flight (DBVF) student competition, where teams design, build, and fly a small electric VTOL aircraft for a set mission. Our aircraft is a search and rescue hexacopter. It is a team project, and the work is the team's.

We are a team of five students: four mechanical engineers and me, a double major in mechanical and electrical engineering. I am the team's electrical engineer, responsible for the electronics, software, and automation. I work on all six electrical areas myself, and I coordinate with the mechanical engineers so the electrical system fits the structure and the payload.
Status: in design. Photos, drawings, and results will be added here as the build produces them.
